payload.title: Search adapter (Rust): FTS index on writes + query route + inspect report
payload.description: Port the search subsystem (TS src/search/*). FrickStore facade has the seam (TODO(FR-245) at facade.rs:1210 'project + upsert into the search adapter' on object upsert/delete). Needs: per-schema searchable-field projection, SQLite FTS5 index maintained on every object write/delete (Postgres tsvector for the PG arm), a search query route, and the GET /_frick/inspect/search adapter-health report (currently stub_not_available). Parity ref: deleted apps/server/src/search + TS FR-24.
